execution_rules: Reserve each session and image payload durably before process creation. Failed sessions consume the same cap. Existing attempt directories forbid replacements.
Use one real original shared Store job and at most two concurrent independent original CLI processes; adjudication is a later separate Store stage.

Recheck current committed original-host ownership, fixed grant deadline and source/consumer hashes. Check original process lifetimes, Store terminal records and immutable artifacts before downstream stages.
Never change model/provider or add a paid service. Clear account/API environment credentials from assessor children; use the existing local ChatGPT CLI authentication.

Bound retained logs and all task outputs, including checks and failed attempts, to the granted total. Near the fixed deadline stop launching; terminate only directly verified owned process lifetimes if required for bounds.
name: independent-familiar-source-scene-review-v1
remaining: All four eligibility flags stay false; complete independent rally references remain 0/2. A separate frozen diagnostic is needed before measuring any shuttle improvement.

scene_codes.L: Supported live broadcast play context; a visible court alone is insufficient.
scene_codes.N: Explicit non-play context such as titles, graphics or between-play presentation.
scene_codes.R: Replay supported by visible source evidence.
scene_codes.U: Unknown or insufficient reduced-resolution source evidence.

scientific_rules: Every actual native cell gets an explicit scene and transition code. Empty cells are not observations. Every view and duplicate native occurrence remains in the denominator.
Metadata partitions, frame coverage and visible court pixels are not verified live scenes or camera edits. Preserve transition uncertainty and thumbnail limitations.

Each original session is fresh and receives only its scheduled unchanged JPEGs, minimal native source/frame/PTS/hash/caption/protocol context, and its own lane previous continuity note within the same view.
No old labels, models, predictions, coordinates, poses, identities, other-stream reading or tool use enters original assessment. Reject tool-bearing session traces.

Both original streams and all their contradictions/failures must be sealed before fresh adjudication. Adjudication uses only targeted scheduled sheets and conflicting/unknown source-only claims, with its own source reasons.
Never use majority voting, silently resolve overlap disagreements, convert unknowns to negatives, overwrite original readings or credit unavailable original streams as independent evidence.
Coarse scene agreements remain independent agent evidence, not expert gold, exact contacts, native identities, complete rallies or deployable-model accuracy.

transition_codes.C: Visible camera edit/transition into this native cell.
transition_codes.S: Visible same-camera continuity from preceding native cell.
transition_codes.X: First native cell of the original view; no predecessor in this view.
